residual_risks: Source backup is dated 2026-10-26; later WordPress changes are not available in this backup.
90 original codes and some source histories cannot attach to current accounts/curricula; all are preserved in the protected archive without recreating deleted users or issuing certificates.
Preserved pending reviews are not publicly published or automatically converted to current Review entries. Source HTML layout is retained in JSON but rendered as safe text.
Private archive data and DB are on the same EC2 disk; existing backup retention is not offsite. Preserve the source backup and private files for disaster recovery.
Files are buffered during authenticated download; very high concurrency or much larger future attachments may require streaming.

Metadata generator was invoked with .cjs added to its in-memory extension set so the CommonJS importer receives the same Git-derived ranges and hash validation as other source files; the installed skill file was not modified.
